_meta.note: Values sampled at the coordinates in lib/data/sites.ts. For the Artemis III regions these are the namesake feature's centre, not a landing ellipse. 'value' is the mean over 'sample'; 'sd' and 'range' (10th–90th percentile) describe the spread inside that area.

thermalInertiaDay.dataset: MGS TES thermal inertia maps (Putzig & Mellon 2007)
thermalInertiaDay.note: Thermal inertia: how well the ground holds heat. Low values mean fine dust (big day–night swings); high values mean rock, crust or ice-cemented soil. Units J m⁻² K⁻¹ s⁻½ (tiu).
